summaries.text:
Drug Price Transparency Act of 2023
 This bill provides statutory authority for the limitation on which type of prescription drug rebates are exempt from federal anti-kickback laws.

 Specifically, a rebate from a drug manufacturer to a health insurer or pharmacy benefit manager is exempt only if the rebate (1) is disclosed to the consumer at the point of sale, or (2) is a flat fee paid for pharmacy benefit management services.

Drug Price Transparency Act of 2023
 This bill provides statutory authority for the limitation on which type of prescription drug rebates are exempt from federal anti-kickback laws.

 Specifically, a rebate from a drug manufacturer to a health insurer or pharmacy benefit manager is exempt only if the rebate (1) is disclosed to the consumer at the point of sale, or (2) is a flat fee paid for pharmacy benefit management services.
